General map showing selected buildings and residences with names of owners. Also covers town of Bridgewater before its incorporation as a separate town in 1856. Served as basis for 1853 printed version, "Map of New Milford, Litchfield Co., Conn., surveyed by L. Fagan." Relief shown by hachures. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Includes insets of villages of New Milford and Bridgewater and ill. Imperfect: Brittle, torn, soiled, title area cut from map, annotated in pencil, mounted on cloth backing. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
